mapper.sql: select cargo_id, order_id, sort_num, cargo_name, quantity, unit, volume, weight, remark from tms_order_cargo
mapper.select: where order_id = #{orderId} and is_del = '0' order by sort_num asc, cargo_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into tms_order_cargo( order_id, sort_num, cargo_name, quantity, unit, volume, weight, remark, is_del, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time )values( #{orderId}, #{sortNum}, #{cargoName}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{volume}, #{weight}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )

insert into tms_order_cargo( order_id, sort_num, cargo_name, quantity, unit, volume, weight, remark, is_del, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time ) values
( #{item.orderId}, #{item.sortNum}, #{item.cargoName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unit}, #{item.volume}, #{item.weight}, #{item.remark}, '0', #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update tms_order_cargo set is_del = '1', update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update tms_order_cargo set is_del = '1', update_time = sysdate() where cargo_id = #{cargoId}
